title: What Comes Next and Why: Interpretable Next-Event Prediction with Neuro-Symbolic Rules
abstract: arXiv:2610.31114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In real-world applications, being able to explain why a prediction is made is often as important - if not more so - than achieving high accuracy. However, existing methods for sequential event prediction typically prioritize accuracy at the expense of interpretability. Neuro-symbolic approaches offer a promising direction to improve interpretability by learning symbolic rules, but extending them to next-event prediction is challenging due to the presence of temporal dependencies. We introduce RULES, a neuro-symbolic model that learns sequential rules directly from data, and combine it with a residual network to form RUNES (Rule Network for Event Sequences). RULES accurately recovers ground truth rules from synthetic data and discovers compact, interpretable rule sets on real data. translated_title: 接下来会发生什么以及为什么：基于神经符号规则的可解释下一事件预测
translated_abstract: 在现实世界的应用中，能够解释预测为何被做出往往与实现高准确率同等重要——甚至更为重要。然而，现有的序列事件预测方法通常以牺牲可解释性为代价来优先追求准确性。神经符号方法通过学习符号规则为提升可解释性提供了一个有前景的方向，但由于时序依赖性的存在，将其扩展到下一事件预测具有挑战性。我们提出了RULES，一个直接从数据中学习序列规则的神经符号模型，并将其与残差网络相结合，形成RUNES（事件序列规则网络）。RULES能够从合成数据中准确恢复真实规则，并在真实数据上发现紧凑且可解释的规则集。RUNES将这些规则以加法方式与残差网络结合，在提供对激活规则及残差作用机制的透明访问的同时，实现了具有竞争力的准确率。
tldr: 提出了神经符号模型RULES及其与残差网络结合的RUNES框架，通过从数据中直接学习可解释的序列规则，在下一事件预测中同时实现了有竞争力的准确率和透明的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RULES, a neuro-symbolic model that learns interpretable sequential rules directly from data, and RUNES, which combines these rules with a residual network to achieve competitive next-event prediction accuracy while maintaining transparent interpretability.
